body:
Part of #4001 — one campaign slice only; merging must not close the anchor.

## What this closes

`IndexSchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`) — 批 20's ONE deliberately-held site — converts from plain `z.object` (silent `.strip`) to the shared `strictObject` template, finishing `object.zod.ts` at 14 of 14. The hold's evidence was re-verified spent on today's trees:

- **#5248 answered (remove)**: `type`/`partial` retired at PR #5842 with `retiredKey` tombstones + the protocol-17 migration — confirmed present on `origin/main`.
- **#5247 → objectui#4772 MERGED** (`9a3d04e` on objectui `main`): `FALLBACK_SCHEMAS.index` now offers exactly `name` / `fields` / `unique`, converged to this schema — the drifted `where`/`brin` controls are gone. Re-read from objectui `origin/main` (`c4533dc`) this session.
- **Producer sweep**: no example app, package fixture, or sibling-repo producer emits `indexes[].where` (examples declare `fields`-only indexes; the driver consumes `name`/`fields`/`unique` only).

## The contract half (campaign ruling: strict must be fixable, not just loud)

- `where` — the console's drifted spelling from the fork window — carries a curated `guidance` entry: the database-layer prescription (`CREATE [UNIQUE] INDEX … WHERE` from a runtime migration, the `ensureOverlayIndex` pattern). Deliberately NOT a rename onto the retired `partial` tombstone — that would be the campaign's finding 7, a suggestion pointing into a second rejection. `brin` needs no key-level work: it was a value of the retired `type`, whose tombstone answers it.
- **Tombstone survival pinned (the #5114-class regression the dispatch named):** `type`/`partial` are declared keys, so the strict unknown-key path never sees them — each still answers its own migration prescription, asserted per key on the message text in §4. A near-miss (`partail`) is NOT pointed at the tombstone (`acceptsNothing` exclusion, asserted).

## Three-place sync (one PR, per the dispatch)

1. Schema close + JSDoc rewrite (the hold section now records the close and its provenance).
2. `object-strictness-batch20.test.ts` §4 flipped from pinning the strip to pinning the close: declared keys at every ADR-0120 `unique` spelling, refusal at own path AND through the carrier, the curated `where` prescription with anti-vacuity + sibling-key controls, tombstone survival.
3. Strictness ledger: `object.zod.ts` row LEFT the remaining-strip map by reaching zero (the `memory.zod.ts`/`analytics` precedent); triage row and section prose record the close; counts regenerated via `gen:strictness-ledger`, never hand-patched.

Plus the campaign's post-cut clause (PR #8666/#8695 precedent): changeset `minor` + **BREAKING** + `adr-0087: registered object-index-unknown-keys-refused`, semantic entry under protocol 18, `gen:migration-registry` run.

## File-surface amendment (declared at claim time as REGION level; two additions, same round)

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-authoring-lint.test.ts` — the evidence-phase lint used `indexes[]` as its nested-strip probe site (its own comments said "when that closes, this describe block is genuinely finished"); three fixtures flipped to the hand-off assertion (lints clean AND parse rejects), per the file's established idiom. Mandated by the fixture-sweep discipline (the rule's consumption radius, not the edited file).
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-index-unknown-keys-refused.ts` + regenerated `registry.ts` — mandated by the post-cut ADR-0087 clause.

Both are disjoint from sibling #8934's surface (`ui/view.zod.ts` / `data/filter.zod.ts`); no regenerated `content/docs/references/**` moved at all (the close changed no `.describe()` text — `check:docs` compared clean), so the one anticipated shared surface with #8934 is empty in this PR.

## Reverse verification (committed first; predicted direction: red)

Restored from the committed fix; suite re-run green.

Example validates green: example-showcase, example-crm, example-todo (first attempt used wrong filter names and matched zero projects — caught via the zero-match trap, re-run with real package names and real output confirmed).
